panels.art: Tense two-shot in the cold last-door hall: on the right a child-sized Silent (1.4 m) with a frayed vermilion cord on its left wrist holds out one thin paper-white hand toward Mira; on the left Mira stands frozen, backpack on the floor at her feet, her right hand gripping the vermilion cord on her left wrist. The high black door looms behind the child. Ash-grey light, teal shadow on the floor.

lines.ru: Мира не двигается. Перед ней тот, кого она искала три года. И она не может сделать ни шага навстречу.

lines.en: Mira. Come. It is cold.
lines.ru: Мира. Иди сюда. Мне холодно.
lines.delivery: thin hollow child-like voice, soft and cold, pleading gently

lines.en: She can't say the word. I don't know the word.
lines.ru: Она не может сказать это слово. А я его не знаю.
lines.delivery: tense inner whisper, urgent worry, helpless frustration

panels.art: Low-angle shot: Dan throws his whole weight against the huge black door with both palms; the door has opened only a hand's width and stopped, a thin line of pale light in the gap. The System window floats at the upper right, tilted, unbothered.

lines.en: Push! Push!
lines.ru: Толкайся! Ну же!
lines.delivery: strained effortful shout, shoving a huge door with all his weight

lines.en: This door wants more. Not a word.
lines.ru: Этой двери нужно больше. Не слово.
lines.delivery: flat dry system observation, cool and unhelpful, calm and exact

lines.en: Almost. Ask me later.
lines.ru: Почти. Спроси позже.
lines.delivery: flat dry, evasive, quietly teasing, patient

panels.art: Wide shot from the door looking back down the hall: three tall Silent walk in from the far entrance in a calm line. In the foreground Dan spins around with one arm thrown out, glowing vermilion lettering bursting from his mouth (lettering added later); the nearest Silent is frozen mid-step. Mira beside him, pale.

lines.en: They come. They are behind us.
lines.ru: Идут. Они у нас за спиной.
lines.delivery: breathless low warning, tight with fear, eyes on the hall entrance

lines.en: Stop!
lines.ru: Стой!
lines.delivery: sharp commanding shout, a sudden burst of courage

lines.en: STOP is yours now. Count: two.
lines.ru: STOP теперь твоё. Счёт: два.
lines.delivery: crisp flat system notification, neutral and precise, a slight pause

lines.ru: Слово бьёт, как отдача. В глазах темнеет. Но ближний Безмолвный застыл с поднятой ногой.

panels.art: Dynamic diagonal shot: Dan drags Mira by the wrist toward a narrow side arch in the left wall where stone stairs climb into the dark; Mira looks back over her shoulder. On the right the child-sized Silent with the vermilion cord stands still by the black door, one hand still raised.

lines.en: There is a way! Up there! Come!
lines.ru: Там есть проход! Вон там, наверху! Идём!
lines.delivery: urgent breathless shout, pulling her toward safety, adrenaline

lines.en: Mira. Why do you run?
lines.ru: Мира. Почему ты бежишь?
lines.delivery: hollow smooth voice, soft and sad, a gentle echo behind them

panels.art: Vertical establishing shot of the Stair of Echoes: a vast round shaft, a narrow spiral stone stair without a railing winding up along the wall, the wall covered in thousands of overlapping pale paper sheets like scales. Dan and Mira are two tiny figures on the stair near the bottom; cold teal darkness below, a small warm ochre glow far above.

lines.ru: Лестница эха. Узкие ступени вьются вверх по стене огромной шахты. Стены из бумаги. Перил нет.

lines.en: So many stairs. Mira, are you OK?
lines.ru: Сколько ступенек. Мира, ты в порядке?
lines.delivery: gasping whisper, kind and worried, catching his breath on the stairs

panels.art: Close two-shot on the stair: Mira's gloved hand is clamped over Dan's mouth, her eyes wide in warning. Behind them the paper wall ripples in rings like water, and a small pale faceless shape is peeling itself off the paper lower down the stair. The System window hovers between them.

lines.en: The wall says it back: OK. OK. OK.
lines.ru: Стена отвечает: OK. OK. OK.
lines.delivery: echoing whisper, eerie calm narrator voice, each repeated word fading away

lines.ru: Здесь каждое сказанное слово возвращается. И у эха вырастают руки.

lines.en: Every sound comes back here. Be quiet.
lines.ru: Здесь возвращается каждый звук. Тише.
lines.delivery: dry flat whisper, a quiet system warning, practical

panels.art: Insert shot from above: a torn cream page held against Dan's knee, his hand writing on it with the yellow carpenter pencil; Mira's gloved finger points at the page. Only hands, the pencil and the page; the writing is a few abstract pencil strokes (no readable text).

lines.en: Dan writes: No talk? Mira writes: No sound. Up. Slowly.
lines.ru: Мира пишет: Ни звука. Идём вверх. Медленно.
lines.delivery: calm storyteller voice, quiet and gentle, narrating a silent exchange

lines.en: You write. Good. Paper is quiet.
lines.ru: Ты пишешь. Хорошо. Бумага тихая.
lines.delivery: dry flat system voice, quiet approval, almost warm

panels.art: Medium shot with dry humour: Dan sits on a step sketching a neat little spiral-stair plan on the page like an engineer, tongue between his teeth; the System window floats right in front of his nose, blocking his view. To his left the stair has no wall, only the open shaft.

lines.en: There are many stairs. There is nothing under us.
lines.ru: Тут много ступенек. А под нами пусто.
lines.delivery: weary tired inner voice, dry humor, an engineer counting stairs

lines.en: There are 300 stairs. You are slow.
lines.ru: Тут 300 ступенек. Ты медленный.
lines.delivery: flat sarcastic system voice, dry and exact, a little smug

panels.art: High-angle shot looking down the spiral stair: several turns below, a small pale faceless paper figure with a thin teal mouth-seam crawls up the steps on all fours, paper sheets trailing from its back. Teal darkness under it. Dan and Mira are not in frame.

lines.en: There is a thing behind us. It has my voice. Again.
lines.ru: За нами что-то идёт. У него мой голос. Опять.
lines.delivery: tense frightened inner voice, a whispered dread, slow and uneasy

panels.art: Medium wide shot: on a broad step sits Pip, a skinny 11-year-old boy in a too-big grey flat cap and an oversized patched brown coat, under a small paper umbrella, grinning with a gap in his teeth, one open palm held up; a small brass bell without a clapper hangs on his chest. Around him the paper wall is perfectly still. Dan and Mira stop two steps below, Dan pointing at the boy in disbelief.

lines.ru: Вокруг мальчишки звук не возвращается. У него есть слово: QUIET.

lines.en: Hello, slow people! No sound comes back here.
lines.ru: Привет, медленные! Тут звук не возвращается.
lines.delivery: cheeky fast talkative boy, bright and quick, selling with a grin, an eleven year old street trader

lines.en: A boy? There is a boy on the stairs!
lines.ru: Мальчик? На лестнице мальчик!
lines.delivery: stunned whisper, delighted surprise, baffled to find a child there

lines.en: I am Pip. I sell quiet. One quiet, one word.
lines.ru: Я Пип. Продаю тишину. Одна тишина за одно слово.
lines.delivery: fast cocky kid, grinning, quick sales pitch with a wink

panels.art: Close two-shot: Pip stretches a greedy finger toward the yellow carpenter pencil behind Dan's right ear; Dan leans back and covers the pencil with his hand, surprised at himself. Warm ochre light from above.

lines.en: No words? Then give me the yellow pencil.
lines.ru: Тогда давай жёлтый карандаш.
lines.delivery: greedy, quick and sly, eyes on the pencil, a boy bargaining

lines.en: No. Not the pencil.
lines.ru: Нет. Только не карандаш.
lines.delivery: firm and protective, a quiet stubborn refusal

lines.en: Why not? It is just a pencil.
lines.ru: А почему нет? Это же просто карандаш.
lines.delivery: puzzled inner voice, small and a bit unsettled by his own attachment

panels.art: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Dan: he points down at the stone under the stairs where the thin outline of a hidden low door now glows vermilion in the wall; Pip hangs over the edge of the step staring at it, cap falling off. The System window floats above the glowing outline.

lines.en: I give you a secret. There is a room under the stairs.
lines.ru: Я дам тебе секрет. Под лестницей есть комната.
lines.delivery: calm clever voice, slow and confident, making an offer, like an engineer showing a drawing

lines.en: There is no room. I live here. I know.
lines.ru: Нет там комнаты. Я тут живу. Я знаю.
lines.delivery: defensive fast kid, scoffing, proud of his territory

lines.en: There is a door behind that stone. Look down.
lines.ru: Вон за тем камнем дверь. Посмотри вниз.
lines.delivery: patient and firm, almost gentle, pointing out a fact

lines.en: True.
lines.ru: Правда.
lines.delivery: short dry system confirmation, flat and neutral

panels.art: Medium shot of the three climbing: Pip walks backwards up the stairs in front, one hand raised like a conductor, a soft round bubble of still air around the group; Dan listens to him, Mira frowns with a hand at her ear as if a sound is missing.

lines.en: OK. A good trade. Talk under my hand.
lines.ru: Ладно. Хороший обмен. Говорите под моей рукой.
lines.delivery: cheerful fast kid, pleased with the bargain, quick friendly trader

lines.en: I know her. That is Mira. She sells her sister.
lines.ru: Я её знаю. Это Мира. Она продаёт свою сестру.
lines.delivery: low sly and quick, a gossipy whisper, delivering a secret

lines.en: What does the boy say? I hear nothing.
lines.ru: Что говорит мальчик? Я ничего не слышу.
lines.delivery: tired and suspicious, low voice, puzzled, unable to hear

lines.en: She does not hear that word.
lines.ru: Она не слышит это слово.
lines.delivery: flat cold system notice, soft and sad

panels.art: Close-up on Dan's face, eyes wide behind the taped glasses as everything connects; Pip in soft focus beside him, pointing a thumb down the shaft. In Dan's glasses a faint reflection of a red cord.

lines.en: She sells the whole word. The Keeper has it.
lines.ru: Она продаёт слово целиком. Оно у Хранителя.
lines.delivery: fast hushed whisper, a boy telling a shocking secret, serious for once

lines.en: The small Silent down there is Lina.
lines.ru: А маленький Безмолвный там, внизу, это Лина.
lines.delivery: quick quiet whisper, matter of fact, nodding toward the stair

lines.ru: Царапина на стене. Фреска. Красная нить. Дэн наконец знает слово, которого нет у Миры.

lines.en: Lina. The red cord. Lina is her sister.
lines.ru: Лина. Красная нить. Лина её сестра.
lines.delivery: stunned whispered realization, quiet awe and pain, everything clicking

panels.art: Medium shot: Mira stumbles on a step, one knee down, face grey, a thin vermilion thread trailing from her lips; Dan reaches for her with both hands. The System window between them has a solid vermilion border and inverted colours (warning).

lines.en: Warning. Mira has two breaths.
lines.ru: Предупреждение. У Миры два дыхания.
lines.delivery: grave flat system alarm, cold and exact, urgent

lines.en: Mira! Sit down! Stop!
lines.ru: Мира! Сядь! Стой!
lines.delivery: frightened urgent shout, desperate and tender, lowering her to the step

panels.art: Dark closing shot: Mira collapsed in Dan's arms on the stair, eyes closed, the vermilion thread at her lips; Dan looks up desperately. Above them Pip stands on a higher step, hands in his coat pockets, looking down calmly like someone watching the weather. Far above, a small warm ochre glow.

lines.en: Two breaths. Then no breath. Then she is a Silent.
lines.ru: Два дыхания. Потом ни одного. Потом она Безмолвная.
lines.delivery: fast low boy, grim for once, no cheeky grin, reciting the deadly count

lines.en: Is there help up there?
lines.ru: Там, наверху, есть помощь?
lines.delivery: exhausted and desperate, hoarse, pleading for a way to save her

lines.en: There is a market up there. It is not free, Zero.
lines.ru: Наверху рынок. Он не бесплатный, Зеро.
lines.delivery: quick sly boy, a price-tag voice with a slight shrug, half sorry

grammarNote.title: There is / there are и слова места
grammarNote.body: Чтобы сказать, что где-то что-то есть, английский начинает с there: «There is a door» (одна вещь), «There are many stairs» (несколько). Отрицание: «There is no room». Вопрос получается перестановкой: «Is there help?». Где именно, показывают маленькие слова места: on (на), under (под), behind (за), up (вверх, наверху), down (вниз, внизу). Слово, названное как слово, пишем ЗАГЛАВНЫМИ: STOP.

examples.en: There is a boy on the stairs.
There is a door behind that stone.

quiz.q: Почему на Лестнице эха нельзя говорить вслух?
options: Каждое слово возвращается, и из эха вырастает существо

quiz.q: Чем Дэн заплатил Пипу за тишину?
Сколько дыханий осталось у Миры в конце?
